question: In the RSC Advances study of biochar loading in dual-phase MIL-100(Al)/MIL-110(Al) hybrids for CO2 adsorption, what mass of activated bamboo-derived biochar (A-BC) was used to make BC-10, and what mass for BC-20?
rendered:
According to the excerpts from "Biochar loading modulates pore accessibility and CO2 adsorption in dual-phase MIL-100(Al)/MIL-110(Al) hybrids, page 3":

For the preparation of biochar-containing composites, activated bamboo-derived biochar (A-BC) was added to the precursor solution during the initial sonication step. The A-BC masses used for BC-10 and BC-20 were 37.1 and 83.5 mg, respectively, corresponding to nominal biochar loadings of 10% and 20%, respectively.
